versions.changelog:
- Project terminology updated from "CDK" to "project" throughout docs and install steps
- Install and deployment commands revised to use `cargo-ai project` instead of `cargo-ai cdk`
- References to "CDK project" replaced with "project (the folder holding cargo.json)"
- Outdated technical references and instructions corrected to match new toolchain flows
- Obsolete file `skill-card.md` removed for clarity and maintenance

Version 0.2.1

- Updated documentation for clarity and improved conciseness in README.md and SKILL.md.
- Removed redundant file: skill-card.md.
- No changes to code or functionality; documentation-only update.

Inbound qualification 0.2.0 adds automated research and tiering for inbound leads.

- Added an optional play to tier and summarise each qualified inbound contact using agent research.
- Play runs asynchronously after the initial form response, never blocking the visitor’s experience.
- Updated compatibility to require @cargo-ai/form-sdk 1.0.3 or later.
- Improved documentation to reflect the research and tiering flow.
- New agents, connectors, and settings files added; obsolete skill-card.md removed.

Initial release of inbound-qualification: automate demo form qualification from your website.

- Instantly qualifies demo form submissions using company data, upserts accounts and contacts to shared GTM models, notifies Slack, and replies with a booking link or thank-you.
- Built as a Cargo tool with a public form—no external backend or form vendor required.
- Requires: @cargo-ai/cli with @cargo-ai/cdk 1.0.98+, @cargo-ai/form-sdk 1.0.2+ in the website app, Cargo Hosting, Node.js 22.18+, and a Cargo workspace.
- Clearly documents integration steps, what you can and should customize, and how inbound is routed and qualified.
- Aimed at marketing, sales development, and GTM engineering personas seeking automated, qualified inbound lead flow.
